title: Chapter 159: The Queen Shows Her Power
content:
Chapter 159: The Queen Shows Her Power

Seeing that the flying dragons in the air had stopped attacking, the cavalry of the evil god camp began to fight back. The metal chain hammers of the bear goblin dragon cavalry and the javelins of other cavalry were thrown at the flying dragons in the air.

The flying dragons have data provided by the queen of insects, and their current flight height and distance are within the safe range.

Due to gravity, throwing from bottom to top is very difficult. The originally powerful metal chain hammers and javelins lost enough power when they flew to a certain height and fell down one after another.

The air attack of the cavalry of the evil god camp was ineffective!

500 flying dragons launched another attack, and 500 biological bombs fell into the cavalry of the evil god camp again. Continuous explosions sounded, causing a large number of casualties to the cavalry below.

"All form small teams! Break out in a scattered manner!"

The two attacks of the flying dragons made the priest in charge of command in the evil god army discover the characteristics of the flying dragons' attacks. The more they gathered together, the greater the damage they suffered.

The cavalrymen of the evil god camp who received the order were preparing to break out of the siege, but suddenly countless terrible explosives were shot down from the sky, and violent chain explosions occurred around them!

Seeing that the enemy was about to flee, 5,000 flying dragons immediately gave the enemy a full volley!

A large number of biological bombs were superimposed and exploded, producing a aggregation effect, leading to a more violent explosion!

The Zerg flying dragons began to output at full strength, and each of the 5,000 flying dragons sprayed five biological bombs in succession, totaling .

Under such a fierce attack by the flying dragons, the area under attack below was rumbling for a long time, and the micro-biological bombs flew everywhere with the juice splashed by the explosion. A large number of micro-biological bombs gathered together and caused new explosions!

The liquid that wrapped the biological bombs was the Zerg biological decomposition liquid, which itself had a strong surface killing effect. Coupled with the explosion damage of the biological bombs, ordinary cavalry could not resist such an attack at all, and disappeared with their lizard mounts in the explosion.

The stronger and better-equipped bear goblin dragon cavalry were specially targeted by the flying dragons, and more biological bombs exploded around them.

The five biological bombs ejected by the only three-star flying dragon also fell into them.

Even though their defense capabilities far exceeded those of ordinary cavalry, they also lost a lot of personnel under such fierce and continuous attacks.

When the explosions were over, only a few wounded bear goblin dragon cavalry were still standing in the more than 20,000 cavalry units of the evil army camp. Accompanying them on the field were those cavalry and mounts that were severely injured and fell to the ground. These wounded were struggling and wailing.

Only the evil god priest and the particularly strong bear goblin dragon cavalry general basically withstood the attack of the flying dragon intact.

The flying dragon flew in the sky and no longer attacked the survivors.

The two queens who followed the flying dragon had three-star strength and flew faster. They followed the flying dragon group slowly and stayed with the three-star host.

More than 20,000 cavalry troops of the evil god camp were almost wiped out by the flying dragons. The remaining strong men could be used to test the queen's ability.

A queen hid in the flying dragon group and used her spawning ability to the evil god priest from a distance. The spores launched by the queen were silent, traceless, and pervasive. The evil god priest was invaded by the spores without knowing it.

The evil god priest was about to speak to the bear goblin dragon cavalry general beside him, but suddenly stopped. The priest with devout faith showed a fearful expression on his face!

"Pop!" With a bang, the evil god priest who was blown up all over the sky instantly turned into light and disappeared, without blowing up the faces of the surrounding bear goblin dragon cavalry!

The existence of the evil god priest must be eliminated immediately!

Before the surviving bear goblin dragon cavalry and their generals could react, the parasitic control parasites released by another queen had already invaded their bodies.

The queen began to forcibly deprive them of control over their bodies through parasites. Their brains were invaded and they immediately stood still and stopped moving.

Even those earth dragon mounts that were not seriously injured stood still, they were also under the control of the queen.

In just a moment, all the cavalry except the bear goblin earth dragon cavalry commander and all the earth dragon mounts controlled by the queen started moving again.

Now they look completely different from before.

The uncontrollable aura they had before due to their crazy belief in evil gods completely disappeared, and they became calm and restrained, somewhat like a normal native race.

They silently picked up the silver maces, and under the puzzled gaze of the injured cavalrymen who fell to the ground, they turned all their former comrades into light one by one and turned them into system resources.

They did not even let go of those seriously injured earth dragon mounts.

The Queen forced the control of the general of the bear goblin dragon cavalry, which took a little longer. After successfully controlling the general, Wu Qing realized that the strength of the general of the bear goblin dragon cavalry was two-star.

Practice has proved that the strength of the enemy does have a great impact on the Queen's parasitic control.

The Queen's task was completed, and the Queen recorded the relevant data. The flying dragons in the sky moved again. They attacked the cavalry of the evil god camp who were severely injured but not dead, and completely wiped out the enemy.

It was a waste of time to rely on the parasitic cavalry controlled by the Queen to kill.

In the end, of the more than 20,000 cavalry troops in the evil god camp, only nearly 200 bear goblins and dragon cavalry and their generals who were successfully controlled by the queen, and nearly 400 dragon mounts were left.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading the exciting content!

These cavalry and mounts are all one-star strength, they are not seriously injured, and they are still useful.

The parasites that the queen successfully controlled can be directly taken over by the queen. It can be said that the entire Zerg is the queen. The queen is equivalent to the queen's clone and the queen herself. There is no difference in essence.

Both the bear goblins and the dragons have strong recovery abilities, and the injuries they suffer can heal quickly.

The bear goblins are the iconic race of the evil god camp. They cannot go to Daxia Territory even if they become parasites. This will expose some secrets of the Zerg and attract attention from the outside world.

Temporarily let the Zerg parasitic cavalry leave the battlefield to the east, and the flying dragon group continues to fly east.

The explosion caused by the dragon attack on this battlefield can't be heard far away. The biological bomb of the dragon seems to explode violently, but the sound and light effect is not obvious and the transmission distance is not far.

With the departure of the dragon group and the parasitic cavalry, only a large number of cavalry equipment are left on the battlefield here, waiting for Wu Qing to send people to transport it back.

The direction of the dragon group is a small stronghold of the evil god camp nearby. The Zerg Puppies found a lot of such strongholds during reconnaissance, all of which were transformed from the occupied small territories.

There are usually only a few thousand ordinary soldiers or even militia stationed in the stronghold, responsible for the actual control of an area, clearing the refugees of the local camp and occupying the small territories of the local camp.

The bear goblins that Wu Qing encountered when he first landed should be the militia sent out by these strongholds.

These strongholds are the characteristics of the newly occupied areas of the evil god camp. When the front line of the war moves forward and this place becomes a safe zone, these strongholds will be built into the territory of the evil god camp.

The believers and people in the territory migrate to live here, use the surrounding resources, grow and develop, and provide material support for the endless camp wars ahead.

The flying dragons flew towards the stronghold aggressively, and saw a group of weak militiamen. In order not to destroy the buildings of the stronghold, the flying dragons did not attack.

The queen was behind, and a group of parasites controlled by parasites flew over. One parasite controlled one person, and the queen easily controlled all the evil god believers in the entire stronghold.

With the queen's strength, it is very easy to control ordinary creatures.

After occupying a stronghold, the flying dragons continued to fly, and through the queen, they controlled the strongholds of several evil god camps in this area.

The flying dragons were completely useless and could only guard the queen and run a few laps.

Further east, the Zerg puppies had not been scouted, and the situation was unclear. For the time being, they could not go there in such a high profile.

...

With Wu Qing's consent, a large number of Zerg puppies left the new city, which had been named Guangfu City by everyone, and rushed to the east.

Now there is no shortage of Zerg puppies, and they can be replenished in large quantities at any time. Wu Qing sent out Zerg puppies to control the strongholds of the evil god camp that had just been occupied, and expand the scope of the safe area controlled by the Zerg.

With these forward strongholds, the Zerg puppies can conduct forward reconnaissance with the strongholds as the center, which can give the Guangfu City in the rear more warning time.

In this way, they will have a great advantage in the confrontation with the evil god camp.

Wu Qing also asked Meng to send an alliance army to the battlefield just now to transport the cavalry equipment left on the battlefield.

The reason for sending the alliance army to transport is to tell everyone that the Zerg is already under control in the east of Guangfu City, so that everyone can rest assured.

Feilong continued to take the queen around for a few laps, and waited for the parasitic cavalry led by the parasitic cavalry general to arrive at the stronghold. After a large number of Zerg puppies entered the strongholds, they returned to the Zerg territory along the original route of the Endless Mountains.

Feilong and the queen's debut was very successful.

During the flight, the queen would occasionally release parasites for reconnaissance to some local creatures. The Zerg needed to see the world through the perspective of these local creatures.

After a small battle here, the flying dragon group took the queen out for a walk and easily captured 20,000 cavalry troops of the evil god camp, including 1,000 bear goblin ground dragon cavalry. The queen got the relevant data of their actual combat on the battlefield.

By the way, the parasites subdued some bear goblin ground dragon cavalry, ground dragon mounts and a large number of evil god believers militia, occupying all the evil god camp strongholds in the surrounding areas.

Because the 100 explosive mosquitoes were disposable troops, there was no place to use them for the time being, so they just ran along for a while and did not play a role.
